title: Lightly Smoked Jamaican Potatoes Pilaf
description: A smoky, springy, energizing Jamaican dish featuring poached potatoes, inspired by macrobiotic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large saucepan, bring the water to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to medium-low, add the apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper, and salt.
Cut the potatoes into 1-inch wedges and add them to the saucepan.
Cover the saucepan and simmer for 12 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Using a slotted spoon, transfer the potatoes to a plate.
Strain the cooking liquid through a fine-mesh sieve into a small bowl.
Whisk the strained cooking liquid to combine, then spoon it over the potatoes.
Garnish with chopped scallions, if desired.
Serve warm, or at room temperature.
